Name: Brighter Building Paint
Author: temisthem
Description:
[b][size=4]Robin came back from Zuzu City with some amazing new paint!

Her new paints allow you to have brighter, darker, or even more saturated colors!

*She is not responsible for any consequences that may occur from licking the nuclear green colored paint[/size][/b]

[size=3]Have you ever thought that Robin's paint was rather lackluster? Ever felt that your house deserves better? Cursed at the sky wondering why on Earth does Robin not have white paint?

Well fortunately for you, she now does. 

This mod increases the maximum brightness and saturation, while also decreasing the minimum brightness too!

White paint? Black paint? And everything else that's in between? Robin's got it all (or at least most of it).

[b][size=6]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)

[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Only players with this mod installed will be able to access a wider range of paint colors in the building painting menu. Players without this mod will still be able to see that new white coat of paint on your buildings (probably).

[b][size=6]Configuration:[/size]
[/b]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
Customizable settings include:
- Max Saturation
- Max Brightness
- Min Brightness
[/size]
